content.text:
I wrote the migrated file to `out/module.ts`. The three lodash imports are gone, and I created no other source files.

- **`toSlug`:** it uses `kebabCase` from `es-toolkit`. I compared its output with the compat version on digit-and-uppercase cases, such as `max44_id` giving `max-44-id`, and the two matched. I couldn't compare against lodash itself, because lodash isn't installed. The compat version is built to match lodash, so I'm relying on that.
- **`byNameKey`:** it uses `keyBy` from `es-toolkit` with a small adapter, `(r) => r.name`. The main `keyBy` takes a function rather than a property name. Moving `keyBy` to `es-toolkit/compat` so it could take `'name'` would have grown the bundle from 818 to 3790 bytes, so I kept the adapter.
- **`preview`:** it uses `truncate` from `es-toolkit/compat`, because the main package has no `truncate`. A test string cut to 24 characters with `...` as expected, and short and empty strings came back unchanged.

`npm run size -- out/module.ts` prints 818 bytes (min+gzip) and 100 bytes of own code. I couldn't get a size for the original, because `src/module.ts` fails to build without lodash installed. So I can't confirm the own-code allowance against the original. The file passes `tsc --strict` on its own.
